caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic or sculpted figure of two animals resembling sheep or goats, with one larger and one smaller, both lying down on a rounded, rectangular green base. The larger animal is positioned to the left, with its body curving around the smaller animal, and its head turned slightly forward; its ears are upright, and the interiors of the ears are shaded with red. The smaller animal is nestled closely to the front of the larger animal, facing forward, and is similarly colored. Both figures are rendered in earthy tones, predominately in shades of brown and beige with dark and light mottling, and they share subtle black markings to suggest fur texture. The base on which they rest is painted green with some lighter patches. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, with a single-line rectangular border. There is a small handwritten signature, "Miss Lawry," in the lower right corner.
title: Pa. German Chalkware Lamp and Sheep
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
